Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to correctly synthesize the chronological inconsistency revealed in the initial search results. In Step 1, the WebSurfer provided clear evidence that Lord Patrick Crichton-Stuart (born 1794) was the son of John Stuart, Lord Mount Stuart, who died in January 1794. This creates an impossible timeline (a son born after his father's death). Instead of recognizing this as a definitive disambiguation signal pointing to a different "Lord Patrick Crichton-Stuart" (likely the 1913 figure) or an error in the source data regarding the father's identity, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the data was merely "conflicting" and initiated a redundant search loop. The Planner failed to prioritize the logical impossibility over the surface-level text match, leading to unnecessary repetition of the same queries in subsequent steps without resolving the core ambiguity.
